Do you want to stagger Dot 2's properties, or the three Dots?

Here at 1 s, all three Dots are in the middle of the same move. When everything moves at once, nothing leads the eye.

So Dot 1 goes first, then Dot 2, then Dot 3, each 4 frames after the one before. Leave Dot 1 where it is and move Dot 2 and Dot 3 later. You can select a Dot's keys and drag them later, or drag the middle of its bar. Quick Offset does all of them in one drag: select them, hold Command and Option, and drag.

Play it back and say done.

I moved all of Dot 2's keys (Position, Opacity and Blurriness) 4 frames later, so it now starts at 0.633 s instead of 0.5 s. Edit > Undo reverses it if you want. These previews came back too small to show any difference, so check 1 s in your own comp: Dot 2 should now be a little behind Dot 1.

Dot 3 is yours to stagger. Play it back and say done.
